description: This Java source file defines the immutable model class 'ConfigField' used for representing individual configuration fields within a larger configuration structure in the rusefi project. It includes parsing logic, size calculation, and methods to generate code outputs for TunerStudio and Java field declarations.

classes.name: ConfigField
classes.description: An immutable class representing an individual configurable field, including logic for parsing, size calculation, and generating code for TunerStudio and Java project integrations.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a line of configuration text into a ConfigField object if it matches the pattern.

methods.name: writeTunerStudio
methods.description: Generates TS headers for the field and updates the tsPosition accordingly.

methods.name: writeJavaFields
methods.description: Generates Java code snippets for the field declaration.
